text:
rachel: Morning — kicking off a perf sweep for mariner13b-qlora on staging-dedicated. Need: 1) exact weights S3 path, 2) tokenizer quirks (padding_side/right?), 3) validated serving config (kv cache, 4-bit quant profile). Plan: run batch sweep (1,2,4,8) and seq-lens (64,256,1024) across 3 replicas. Ping if busy. I'll schedule runs at ~10:30 PT. :calendar:

anya: Quick heads-up — I've seen the tokenizer emit a leading space for prompts when pad_token isn't set; that breaks prefix caching and makes batching noisy. Also token_type_ids come back as None for some inputs.

mike: Weights are at s3://redwood-models/mariner/qlora/13b/v1/mariner-13b-qlora.safetensors (sha256: a1b2...c3d4). Grant should be open to staging nodes.

sam: I'll own the bench runs. Proposing the runner command below — will iterate if results look odd:

```bash
python -m bench_runner \
  --model s3://redwood-models/mariner/qlora/13b/v1 \
  --device cuda:0 \
  --batch-sizes 1 2 4 8 \
  --seq-lens 64 256 1024 \
  --quant-profile q4_0 \
  --warmup 50 \
  --steps 200 \
  --prefix-cache true
```

sam: We'll capture per-token latency, p50/p95/p99, throughput (tok/s), and memory. Posting CSV + summary here when done.

anya: For tokenizer, please set `padding_side = "right"` and `pad_token = eos_token`. Patch I used:

```py
# tokenizer fix for mariner-qlora onboarding
tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
tokenizer.padding_side = "right"
tokenizer.truncation_side = "right"
```

anya: That removed the leading-space artifact and made prefix caching stable in my local tests.

jordan: Quick question — what's our SLO baseline for these runs? p95 targets?

rachel: SLOs: p95 < 150ms for seq_len=64, p95 < 350ms for seq_len=1024 on dedicated-prod X2. Note: staging tends to be ~1.1-1.3x slower; we'll flag >15% regression vs baseline.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: mariner-qlora-staging -> nodeset-staging-3 at 2026-03-17T17:30Z (build 2026.03.17-rc2).

sam: Noted. I'll wait for deploy completion then start runs. Also posting the serving config I'm planning to use — can someone glance?

```yaml
model:
  path: s3://redwood-models/mariner/qlora/13b/v1
  quant: q4_0
runtime:
  kv_cache: true
  max_batch_size: 8
  seq_len: 1024
  prefer_low_latency: true
```

mike: Add `kv_cache_shard_size: 32` and `tensor_parallelism: 1` to avoid odd OOMs when batching. Also ensure `max_workspace_bytes` has a sane limit for q4 paths.

anya: Also enforce `tokenizer.truncation_side = "right"` in the server init — some long prompts were mysteriously truncated on the left which affected eval reproducibility.

rachel: Thanks — @sam please ping @mike immediately if you see 403s or weight checksum mismatches. @anya can you open a tiny PR with the tokenizer patches and link it here? I'll pin results to #eng-ml-bench-summaries and follow up with canary plan if numbers look good.

sam: Will do. Starting runs once the deploy clears — will post artifacts (CSV, flamegraphs, short summary) in this thread. :thumbsup:
